# Returns and exchanges

## Return period
You can return items within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unworn, unwashed and have all tags attached, in the original packaging.

## How to return
1. Open the returns portal and enter your order number and email address.
2. Select the items and the reason for the return.
3. Print the prepaid return label and drop the parcel at a DHL or PostNL point.
Returns from Germany and the Netherlands are free. For other EU countries a fee of EUR 6.90 is deducted from the refund.

## Refund
Once we receive the parcel we check it within 2 working days. The refund goes to the original payment method and arrives within 5-7 working days after the check.
Original shipping costs are refunded when the whole order is returned.

## Exchanges
You can exchange an item for another size or colour. Choose "Exchange" in the returns portal. If the new item is out of stock you receive a refund instead.

## Excluded items
For hygiene reasons socks and underwear cannot be returned once the package is opened. Gift cards cannot be returned.
